scripts.check: bun run clean && bun run compile && bun test && bun run test:node && bun run lint && bun run pack:verify
scripts.pack:dry: bun run check && bun pm pack --dry-run
scripts.pack: bun run clean && bun run compile && bun test && bun run test:node && bun run lint && node test/pack-runner.js --keep
scripts.publish:latest: bun run check && bun publish --tag latest
scripts.publish:next: bun run check && bun publish --tag next
scripts.version:patch: bun pm version patch --no-git-tag-version && bun run check
scripts.version:minor: bun pm version minor --no-git-tag-version && bun run check
scripts.version:major: bun pm version major --no-git-tag-version && bun run check
scripts.version:prerelease: bun pm version prerelease --no-git-tag-version && bun run check
scripts.generate: cd ../../schema && protoc -I . -I ./googleapis --plugin=protoc-gen-es=$(cd ../js/sesame-endpoint && bun pm bin)/protoc-gen-es --es_out=../js/sesame-endpoint/src/gen --es_opt=target=ts google/api/field_behavior.proto google/rpc/status.proto sesame/type/netaddr.proto sesame/v1alpha1/tls.proto sesame/v1alpha1/proxy.proto sesame/v1alpha1/remotecontrol.proto
